chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, from Yahya ibn Sabur, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying regarding the deceased: his eye sheds tears at the time of death. He said: That is when he sees the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so he sees what pleases him. Then he (peace be upon him) said: Do you not see the man who sees what pleases him and what he loves, so his eye sheds tears because of that, and he laughs?
ai.seo_question: Why does a believer's eye shed tears at the moment of death according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the spiritual phenomenon of the believer's tears at death as a manifestation of joy upon witnessing the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). He employs a relatable human analogy of overwhelming emotion to clarify that these tears signify the soul's delight in the divine presence, a concept central to Shia eschatology regarding the 'Barzakh' (intermediate realm). This narration underscores the intimate connection between the believer's soul and the Ahl al-Bayt even after physical separation.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Muawiya Bin Wahab, from Yahya Bin Sabour who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding the deceased, tears flowing form his eyes: ‘That is during him seeing Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, so he sees what overjoys him’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Have you not seen the man seeing what overjoys him and what he loves, so his eyes fill up with tears due to that, and he laughs?’
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab from Yahya ibn Sabur who has said the following: “

I heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say about a dying person, ‘His eye tears up (moistens with tears) at the time of his death.’ He then said, ‘This happens upon seeing the Messenger of Allah. He sees what makes him happy.’ He then said, ‘Is it not a fact that when a person sees someone whom he loves his eye tears up (moistens with tears) and he laughs?”’
